title: Emit clean generated source
prompt: Implement `static string EmitDto(string className, (string Name, string Type)[] fields)` returning a complete, compilable C# source string for `public sealed record {className}(...)` with the given fields — using FULLY QUALIFIED types for non-primitives (e.g. System.DateTime) so the output compiles without any usings. Primitives (int, string, bool, double) stay as-is.

tests.name: compiles-without-usings
tests.hint: Generated code must not depend on ambient usings — emit fully qualified names for anything not a primitive keyword.

tests.name: primitives-stay-short
tests.hint: Keep a keyword map for primitives; qualify only the rest.
